integrity: The construction and proof are self-contained except for standard compactness/topological dynamics principles, which are stated where applied. All numerical checks are independent finite corroborations and not infinite proof. No external independent validation or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies continuous surjective shift-equivariant maps only between the specified two-sided generalized period-doubling subshifts. It neither classifies intermediate factors outside this family nor measurable factors. Earlier equivalent statements under alternate Toeplitz semicocycle formulations cannot be ruled out by accessible historical searches. Universal assertions depend on the proof, not finite tests.
title: Arithmetic rigidity of factor maps between generalized period-doubling shifts
